findings.detail: WP-25's own prose declares 14 Definition of Done items; architecture.md, section 21, Definition of Done for the complete P0 program enumerates 15. The two counts disagree.
findings.resolution: all 15 enumerated bullets are implemented as P0-DOD-001 through P0-DOD-015 and evaluated separately. No bullet was merged, renumbered or discarded to reach the declared count. The discrepancy is visible and it permits no item to be ignored.

findings.detail: 1 artifact(s) failed schema validation, resolved through a symlink, or contained credential-shaped content: EV-WP17-001 (data/web/wp17-real-gate-status.json) INVALID: 1 error(s)
findings.resolution: typed INVALID and excluded from supporting any claim. WP-25 does not repair another work package's artifact or its schema. Where a gate reads a different, well-formed field of such an artifact, it still reads it, and this finding is why a reader should treat that gate's evidence as provisional.
